description: Attribution completeness validation for all provenance-blocked records. Validates CC-BY-SA-4.0 attribution and ShareAlike obligations.

CC_BY_SA_4_0: source_url — link to original upstream source
share_alike_notice — must indicate downstream must use same license
changes_marked — if content was modified, must note changes
WIKICHIP_DERIVED: source_url — link to original WikiChip article

has_attribution_text.detail: No attribution text exists in the record's source_attribution block or lineage metadata.

has_source_reference.detail: No original source reference (StackExchange post URL/ID) is stored.

has_source_url.detail: No upstream source URL is present in the record.

has_license_identifier.detail: License is identified as CC-BY-SA-4.0 in the decision record and provenance block.

has_changes_marked.detail: No modifications note exists (content selected from StackExchange but changes not documented).

validation_results.reason: Missing attribution text, source URL, share-alike tracking, and changes documentation. License is identified but no compliance metadata exists.
validation_results.required_action: Add CC-BY-SA-4.0 attribution metadata to the record's source_attribution block: attribution_text crediting the StackExchange author, upstream post URL, share-alike notice, and indication of any content modifications.
human_steps: 1. Identify the exact StackExchange post used as source (author, post URL, date)
2. Construct attribution text: 'This content is based on [Post Title] by [Author] on Stack Exchange (https://...), licensed under CC-BY-SA-4.0.'
3. Add share-alike notice: 'Distributed under the same license (CC-BY-SA-4.0).'
4. Note any content modifications if the original was adapted
5. Write to source_attribution block in the record's lineage metadata

has_attribution_text.detail: No attribution text exists documenting WikiChip as the source.

has_source_reference.detail: No reference to the original WikiChip article is stored.

has_source_url.detail: No upstream WikiChip URL is present in the record.

has_license_identifier.detail: License is noted as 'WikiChip-derived (requires_tracking)' and 'CC-BY-SA-4.0 (verify)' in different contexts.

license_verified.detail: CC-BY-SA-4.0 status has '(verify)' appendix indicating license confirmation is still pending human review.

validation_results.reason: Missing attribution text, source URL, license verification confirmation, share-alike tracking, and changes documentation. License is flagged as requiring verification.
validation_results.required_action: 1) Confirm WikiChip content is licensed under CC-BY-SA-4.0 (resolve the '(verify)' appendix). 2) Add attribution metadata: attribution_text crediting WikiChip, upstream article URL, share-alike notice, and modifications note.
human_steps: 1. Verify the specific WikiChip page used as source carries a CC-BY-SA-4.0 license (check footer or page metadata at https://en.wikichip.org/)
2. Remove or confirm the '(verify)' appendix after human verification
3. Construct attribution text: 'This content is derived from [Article Title] on WikiChip (https://en.wikichip.org/...), licensed under CC-BY-SA-4.0.'
4. Add share-alike notice: 'Distributed under the same license (CC-BY-SA-4.0).'
5. Note any content modifications if the original was adapted
6. Write to source_attribution block in the record's lineage metadata
